hero.subtitle: Software Engineering student at PUC Minas, currently in the 2nd semester.
hero.p1: Since I was a kid, I started using my father's computer, and that sparked a strong interest in technology. In 2016, I learned a bit more about game development and had my first contact with programming.
hero.p2: In 2020, I felt the desire to get into programming. So I started the Programming 1 course at Escola CNI (Prime System), where I learned Programming Logic, Java and a bit of PHP. I really enjoyed it and later took Programming 2, focused on HTML, CSS and WordPress.
hero.p3: After those courses, I became interested in studying Information Technology at university. That's when I found the Software Engineering program at PUC Minas, and I started my degree in the first semester of 2026. During the program, I have been learning Python, web development with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot and agile methodologies such as Scrum.

ecoflux.description: Web platform built to make recycling and selective waste collection more accessible. EcoFlux connects citizens, collection points and partner companies, letting users find collection points, schedule pickups of recyclable materials and follow the collection calendar by region — making the process simpler and more accessible in everyday life.

spaceEscape.description: Space Escape is a 2D game where the player controls a spaceship and must dodge meteors falling across the screen. During a run, repair kits appear at random and can be collected to restore the ship's health. The goal is to survive as long as possible and reach the highest score.
